answer: Each agent bonds a hydrostatic pressure crystal whose acoustic impedance profile is co-registered to a slow-melting glacier of stake-weighted attestations, and any identity claiming a fresh nebula of unproven sensors must first match that profile against the shared benthic ledger. Sybil clusters therefore cannot fork identities without duplicating the costly physical. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
